name: 67530 · Great Bend, KS
findings: ZIP 67530 (Great Bend) has 82 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Economic development organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 67530 (Great Bend) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
